title: SearchRequest
description: Request body for instrument search operations.

View.description: Search view defining the entity types and fields to search across.

Filter.description: OData-style filter expression to narrow search results.

Select.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return.

Top.description: Maximum number of results to return.

OrderBy.description: Field name and sort direction for ordering results.

Boost.description: Boosting expression to influence result ranking.
